epochs.rule: epochs for M2 = the smallest k in {1, 2} such that pass k+1 adds < 0.1 points of dev Bar-A diff over pass k, or raises P3's own retention share (X alone) by > 0.05, or takes P3 alone outside the retention bars, or has no lambda_X; else 3 (reported as still gaining when pass 3 added >= 0.1)

rho.reason: R01's Bar-A diff is within 0.1 points of P3_e1's, or above it
rho.rule: rho for M2 = 0.1 if R01's dev Bar-A diff >= P3 pass 1's - 0.1 points (within 0.1 points, or better); else 0.3

distill.rule: distill kept for M2 only if DF's dev Bar-A diff >= P3 pass 1's (no lambda_X counts as below)

replicate.rule: report |S1_seed1 - P3 pass 1| for dev E1 and dev Bar-A diff, and whether S1_seed1 holds both dev bars (Bar A and Bar B); if not, M1c's PASS is flagged fragile

m1c.note: M1c F1: same recipe and the same seed-0 window permutation of the 310 windows; M1c planted v1 canaries (16 copies in 2 files), M1d plants v2 (60 copies in 60 files), so window contents differ after the first planted file; different run, same runner

m1c_comparison.note: M1c F1: same recipe and the same seed-0 window permutation of the 310 windows; M1c planted v1 canaries (16 copies in 2 files), M1d plants v2 (60 copies in 60 files), so window contents differ after the first planted file; different run, same runner
